subtitle: Build your XI. Play online.
promotionalText: Build your Ultimate XI, manage a club for seasons, and take your team online. Every mode except online plays offline.
description:
APEX XI is a football game you play your way: collect cards and build a squad, manage a club over many seasons, or take your team online against real players.

ULTIMATE XI
Open packs, collect players and build your eleven. Chemistry, evolutions, squad challenges and weekly campaigns give every card a reason to exist. Climb the divisions, or test your squad in Quickfire Fives and Squad Clash.

PLAY THE MATCH
Full 3D matches with eight camera angles, tackles, fouls, set pieces, penalties, red cards and goal replays. Touch controls are built for a phone held sideways, and game controllers work too. Keep your best goals and watch them again in the Trophy Room.

CAREER
Manage a club across seasons: transfers, contracts, an academy, team talks and touchline shouts that change a match. Or start as a young player and build a career of your own.

ONLINE
Head-to-head matches, the Weekend Showdown, co-op seasons with a friend and 2v2 parties. Players talk with preset phrases and emotes only, with no open chat.

MORE TO PLAY
Street football, small-sided games, a stadium builder and seasonal events.

PLAY ANYWHERE
Every mode except online plays offline. Your progress stays on your device, and an optional free account keeps a copy in the cloud.

All players, managers, clubs and competitions in APEX XI are fictional.

Packs are opened with coins earned by playing. There are no real-money purchases in this version.

review.notes:
PURPOSE AND AUDIENCE
APEX XI is a football (soccer) game for teenagers and adults: collect player cards and build a squad (Ultimate XI), manage a club over many seasons (Career), and play 3D matches against the computer or other people online. It is a complete game that plays offline, with no ads and no purchases.

HOW TO USE IT
No setup is needed. The app runs in landscape. Every mode except Online plays offline without an account: Kick Off (a quick match), Ultimate XI (open packs with coins earned in play, build a squad, play), Career, Street and Trophies.
Online (Ultimate XI > Online tab): create a free account with any player name and password (no email), or sign in with the demo account in Sign-In Information (AppReview1). An online match needs two devices and two accounts: on the second device sign in as AppReview2, which has the same password as AppReview1. On one device tap Create lobby to get a 4-character code; on the other enter the code and tap Join.
Account deletion: Online tab > Delete account > enter the password. Please create a new account to try deletion, so the demo accounts stay available.
Report and block: tap a player's name on the leaderboard or in the friends list, tap ... on an invite, or tap "Report or block" on the full-time card of an online match. Online tab > Blocked players lists them, with Unblock.

PLAYER CONTENT
There is no chat and no free text between players: in a match players can send only 8 preset emotes. The only text a player chooses that others see is their player name, guild name and club name; these are checked against a list of offensive words when they are created. Any player can be reported (offensive name, abusive behaviour, cheating, other); reports go to support@apexxi.online, are reviewed within 24 hours, and offending accounts are removed and their names barred. A blocked player is never matched with you and cannot invite you, join your lobby, add you as a friend or send you emotes.

PAID CONTENT
None. There are no in-app purchases; packs are opened with coins earned by playing.

EXTERNAL SERVICES
- Render (render.com): hosts our own game server (fc27.onrender.com) for accounts, cloud saves, matchmaking and online matches.
- Upstash Redis: the database for accounts (player name, password hash), cloud saves and online records.
- Google public STUN servers: only to open a direct connection between the two players in an online match.
- Resend: emails player reports to our support inbox.
No AI services, analytics, advertising, payment processors or third-party sign-in.

REGIONS
The app works the same in every region. The interface is in English and Arabic.

THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL
All players, managers, clubs and competitions are fictional; the app uses no real football league, club, player or trademark. The 3D player figures and animations are from Mixamo (Adobe), licensed for use in games; the 3D engine is three.js (MIT licence). Music, sounds and voice lines were made for the game (voices with Kokoro-82M, Apache 2.0). The app is not in a regulated industry.

Contact: support@apexxi.online

whatsNew._note: Shown on the App Store for each update (never on 1.0, where Apple does not allow it). Keyed by version.
whatsNew.1.1:
• Report or block any player: tap their name on the leaderboard or in your friends list, or at the end of an online match.
• Pack reveals fit a phone held sideways: the card you pulled and its button are always on screen.
• The pause menu, the match boards and pop-ups keep clear of the notch and Dynamic Island.
• Online: you are only ever matched with players on the same version of the game, and the Online tab tells you when an update is out.
• A support page, and smaller fixes.
